grid.title: Relação de Vendas/Produtos por Previsão de Entrega
grid.expression: SELECT V.CODPROD, V.DESCRPROD, V.CODVOL, SUM(CASE WHEN V.MES = 1 THEN V.QTDNEG ELSE 0 END) AS JANEIRO, SUM(CASE WHEN V.MES = 2 THEN V.QTDNEG ELSE 0 END) AS FEVEREIRO, SUM(CASE WHEN V.MES = 3 THEN V.QTDNEG ELSE 0 END) AS MAR, SUM(CASE WHEN V.MES = 4 THEN V.QTDNEG ELSE 0 END) AS ABRIL, SUM(CASE WHEN V.MES = 5 THEN V.QTDNEG ELSE 0 END) AS MAIO, SUM(CASE WHEN V.MES = 6 THEN V.QTDNEG ELSE 0 END) AS JUNHO, SUM(CASE WHEN V.MES = 7 THEN V.QTDNEG ELSE 0 END) AS JULHO, SUM(CASE WHEN V.MES = 8 THEN V.QTDNEG ELSE 0 END) AS AGOSTO, SUM(CASE WHEN V.MES = 9 THEN V.QTDNEG ELSE 0 END) AS SETEMBRO, SUM(CASE WHEN V.MES = 10 THEN V.QTDNEG ELSE 0 END) AS OUTUBRO, SUM(CASE WHEN V.MES = 11 THEN V.QTDNEG ELSE 0 END) AS NOVEMBRO, SUM(CASE WHEN V.MES = 12 THEN V.QTDNEG ELSE 0 END) AS DEZEMBRO, V.RAZAOSOCIAL FROM ( SELECT ITE.CODPROD, PRO.DESCRPROD, ITE.CODVOL, SUM((ITE.QTDNEG - ITE.QTDENTREGUE)) AS QTDNEG, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAB.DTPREVENT) AS MES, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAB.DTPREVENT) AS ANO, PAR.CODPARC || '-' || PAR.RAZAOSOCIAL AS RAZAOSOCIAL FROM TGFITE ITE INNER JOIN TGFCAB CAB ON (ITE.NUNOTA = CAB.NUNOTA AND CAB.STATUSNOTA = 'L') INNER JOIN TGFPRO PRO ON ITE.CODPROD = PRO.CODPROD INNER JOIN TGFPAR PAR ON CAB.CODPARC = PAR.CODPARC WHERE (:P_CODPROD IS NULL OR ITE.CODPROD = :P_CODPROD) AND (:P_CODPARC IS NULL OR CAB.CODPARC = :P_CODPARC) AND CAB.TIPMOV = 'P' AND CAB.DTPREVENT IS NOT NULL AND CAB.PENDENTE = 'S' AND ITE.PENDENTE = 'S' AND (CAB.CODEMP = 501 OR CAB.STATUSNFE <> 'D') AND (ITE.QTDNEG - ITE.QTDENTREGUE) > 0 AND (:P_CODGRUPOPROD IS NULL OR PRO.CODGRUPOPROD = :P_CODGRUPOPROD) GROUP BY ITE.CODPROD, PRO.DESCRPROD, ITE.CODVOL, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CAB.DTPREVENT), EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAB.DTPREVENT), PAR.CODPARC || '-' || PAR.RAZAOSOCIAL ORDER BY ITE.CODPROD ) V WHERE V.ANO = :P_ANO GROUP BY V.CODPROD, V.DESCRPROD, V.CODVOL, V.RAZAOSOCIAL ORDER BY V.CODPROD
